card.name: Big number scales after ten
card.fires_on: The scale word (million, billion) right after a number like 10 or ten, and digits inside numbers that begin with 1 (such as 10, 10.9, 1.007). It appears in science, gardening and dose or concentration text.

modes.label: Scale word after ten
modes.description: Million or billion following 10 or ten in astronomy and general science text.
modes.example: 10<< billion>> years after the creation of the universe.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A later digit within a number that starts with 1, often a decimal or a range like 6-10.
modes.example: 10.<<9>> g. The patient suffered a grand mal

card.plain: It marks the spot in a number like 10 million or 10.9 where the number is still being written out.
